messages.message:
USB Camera and c922 Pro Stream Webcam share USB bandwidth: both connect through the same USB hub (USB2.1 Hub 05E3:0610) on port 13 (HS13) of the Intel(R) USB 3.20 eXtensible Host Controller.
If I open them both at the same time, one of them will probably fail with a USB bandwidth error (predicted from the USB layout, not yet tried).
At these settings they need about 101% of what that USB 2.0 link allows (USB Camera 1280x720 MJPEG 30 fps: 62%, c922 Pro Stream Webcam 1280x720 MJPEG 30 fps: 40%).
Suggest moving one of those cameras to any of the following controller ports:
  Intel(R) USB 3.20 eXtensible Host Controller: port 1 (HS01, USB 3, not USB-C, user-accessible), port 2 (HS02, USB 3, not USB-C, user-accessible), port 4 (HS04, USB 3, not USB-C, user-accessible), port 5 (HS05, USB 3, not USB-C, user-accessible), port 6 (HS06, USB 3, not USB-C, user-accessible), port 7 (HS07, USB 3, not USB-C, user-accessible), port 12 (HS12, USB-C, user-accessible), port 9 (HS09, USB-C), and 5 more
Or, to keep both where they are, lower c922 Pro Stream Webcam to 640x480 MJPEG 30 fps (about 13%).
